messages.subject: Airports of Thailand | Aviation infrastructure, sustainability and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Airports of Thailand Leadership Team,

AOT's role in national aviation infrastructure requires strong alignment across government, regulators, communities and operating teams. That is closely aligned with my current executive responsibilities.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My institutional interfaces include civil aviation authorities alongside mining, environmental, energy, labour, security and standards agencies.

I bring experience coordinating official approvals, operating requirements, remote-site aviation, executive stakeholder matters and sustainability initiatives. My recent renewable-energy and carbon-governance work adds further relevance to airport decarbonization and infrastructure strategy.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand leadership roles across Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships or stakeholder strategy. I have attached an AOT-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
